title: Day-to-day admin for ZPA (connectors, Service Edges, PRA and user portals, provisioning keys, Browser Access certificates), Client Connector (device removal single and bulk, bypass apps, entitlements) and ZDX (deep trace, read-only views)
standards: OWASP Top 10 2021 A01 A02 A04 A09

checks.what: Each family refuses before any read when its product is not ticked (engine, picker, lookup, follow route)
Payload oracles: connector, group, Service Edge group, PRA console, segment, provisioning key, certificate, ZCC removal, bypass app, entitlement and deep trace bodies
Every delete or removal asks the typed phrase whatever the count, naming the object or the count and kind
Connected, used or renamed ZPA objects and bypass apps a profile uses are kept and named
A change made after the preview is a plan_changed or a conflict, never overwritten
Undo for updates, key creates, certificate rotations, bypass create/edit, entitlements and trace starts; deletes say they have none
Provisioning key, certificate private key and device OTP canaries reach no plan, result, record, log, audit entry or job poll
The deep trace follow reads at most MAX_POLLS times, at least MIN_INTERVAL apart, Stop ends it
Deep trace starts per tenant and per device, and the Client Connector hourly call budget, are enforced
The device removal plan and result CSV are spreadsheet-safe and offer counts only

findings.title: The Browser Access private key would have been written to the audit log's request record (the field name key_pem is not secret-named)
findings.fix: The upload field is private_key, which audit.redact redacts; a route test reads every file, answer and log.

findings.title: An error answer that quotes the refused request would carry the certificate and key into results, logs and the audit log
findings.fix: Errors of the upload are scrubbed of PEM blocks, every key line and long base64 runs before pack_ops sees them.

findings.title: The Undo of a schedule change could not be planned: ZPA's default update time (66600 s, 18:30) is not a whole hour
findings.fix: The undo form accepts whole minutes; the page still offers whole hours.

findings.title: A portal was refused as in use by a console deleted earlier in the same run
findings.fix: Objects deleted earlier in the run no longer count as users; the later delete depends on the earlier one.

findings.title: The upload held for one person could not be used by the synchronous preview (no actor in its audit scope)
findings.fix: The waited-for preview runs as the requesting actor, as the job route does.

findings.title: The pasted device list did not reach the matcher (the lookup body had no text field)
findings.fix: The lookup request carries text, mode and domain; a route test matches a list.

notes: ASSUMED and marked in code and in every plan's notes: moving an App Connector by PUT /connector/{id} with appConnectorGroupId; certBlob as the upload field; the ZCC custom IP-based app create/edit/delete paths and the entitlement update body (the SDK has no usable write); device state words; ZDX trace status words; ZDX user search by q.

Verified in zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3: every other path, method and model field; Client Connector's 100 calls an hour (zcc/legacy.py); the version profile ids (utils.pick_version_profile); the deep trace options and lengths.
